title: Read text and quantities
subtitle: input receives text. Convert it to a number before doing arithmetic.
concept: input receives text. Convert it to a number before doing arithmetic.
intuition: Typing 3 first supplies the character 3; conversion makes it a quantity.
objectives: Read one line from the user
Convert a quantity from text to a number

body.title: Read one line from the user
body.text: name = input() waits for a line. Pressing Enter delivers the text to name, without the final newline. You can first display print("What is your name?") to explain what to enter. Text values are called strings.

body.title: Convert a quantity from text to a number
body.text: Read count = int(input()) in two stages: input() receives text, then int(...) converts integer text such as "3" to the number 3. Now count + 2 can increase a quantity. Text such as "three" or "3.5" fails this integer conversion. Lesson 4.4 explains how to handle such errors.

body.title: Insert variables into a message
body.text: In print(f"Hello, {name}"), f marks a string whose brace fields are filled with values. {name} is replaced by the variable's value. This basic form is enough for now. To display a count by itself, print(count) also works.

formalDefinition.text: input() reads a string; int(...) converts valid integer text to a number; an f-string inserts values using {variable_name}.
conditions: int requires valid integer text. Empty text, "three", and "3.5" cannot be converted directly to integers.

workedExamples.problem: Enter 3 and display the quantity after adding 2.
steps: int converts it to the number 3.

commonMistakes.claim: input automatically turns text that looks numeric into a number.
commonMistakes.correction: input returns a string. Use int before integer arithmetic.

commonMistakes.claim: Adding two quoted quantities gives their numerical sum.
commonMistakes.correction: "3" + "2" concatenates to "32". Use numbers for arithmetic.

learningCheck.question: After input reads "3", how can you add 2 to the quantity?
choices: Convert to a number with int first
Quote 2 too, then add the strings
